description:
Hey Reachy is an unofficial app for the Reachy Mini desktop robots, native on iPhone, iPad and Mac. It is not Pollen Robotics' own app, and it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Pollen Robotics or Hugging Face.

This is its Apple TV app. It shows the robot's camera full screen on your TV. You drive the robot from the sofa with a game controller or the Siri Remote. It talks to a robot on your own network directly, and it needs no account.

TRY IT WITHOUT A ROBOT

On the Connect screen, "Try without a robot" opens a session with a robot the app carries itself — no robot, no network, no account. You can wake it and drive it, and the drive screen shows its head and body angles as they change. It has no camera, because the camera belongs to a machine that does not exist.

WHAT IT DOES

• Connect — the app finds robots on your network with Bonjour, or at an address that you type with the remote. It connects to the last robot again by itself, and it tries known addresses again when a robot comes on later.

• Wake and sleep — one button wakes the robot or puts it to sleep. When the robot's motors and camera are off, the same button starts them first. The screen shows the robot's name, its address and its state.

• Camera — the drive screen shows the robot's camera full screen, and the robot's sound plays on the TV. The camera also runs while the robot sleeps, so you can watch without driving.

• Game controller — the right stick turns the head to look around. The left stick turns the body and raises or lowers the head. The shoulder buttons tilt the head, the triggers move the antennas, and one button moves the robot back to neutral.

• Siri Remote — drag on the touch surface to look around, and hold at the side to turn the body. Play/Pause moves the robot back to neutral, and Back closes the drive screen.

• Limits — every command goes through the robot's own daemon and its limits. The controller lets go when the robot sleeps, when you close the drive screen and when the app goes to the background. It does not drive the robot while the robot wakes up.

The Apple TV app needs a robot that is already on your network. To put a new robot onto Wi-Fi, install robot apps or update its software, use Hey Reachy on an iPhone, an iPad or a Mac. A robot that needs a software update says so, and the TV sends it no commands.

English, German, Spanish, French and Russian.

PRIVACY

Nothing is collected. The app talks to your robot and, if you sign in, to Hugging Face with your own account. There is no server on our side.

A NOTE ON YOUR NETWORK

The robot's daemon provides no authentication and no encryption of its own. Use Hey Reachy on a trusted private network or on the robot's own access point — never through a port forward or a public address.

Hey Reachy is an independent client for the robot daemon's documented HTTP and WebSocket API. "Reachy Mini" is a product name of Pollen Robotics, used here solely to describe what this app is compatible with.

Requires tvOS 26.
promotionalText: Watch a Reachy Mini's camera full screen and drive the robot from the sofa, with a game controller or the Siri Remote — or try the simulator inside the app.
